title: Ansel and the Will
author: Jude Crane
blurb: Hazel Iversen, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
